message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine which charges from the lexicon apply to the described facts.

Facts: A company and its executives engaged in fraud: they pretended to have investment, forged bank documents, signed construction contracts, collected deposits, guarantee money, etc. This is contract fraud (合同诈骗). Also possibly "诈骗" (general fraud) but the lexicon includes "合同诈骗" specifically for contract fraud. Also "非法占用农用地" maybe because they occupied farmland without compensation, but the main criminal charge is fraud. The description: "以收取图纸押金和合同保证金等名义，共骗取多名受害人财物" => contract fraud. Also "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" maybe because they forged bank documents (China Construction Bank deposit slips). That's forging bank documents, which are not necessarily state documents, but bank documents maybe considered "国家机关公文"? Not sure. The lexicon includes "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". Bank documents are not state documents. So maybe not.

Also "非法占用农用地" because they occupied farmland without compensation. The fact says they "占用农民耕地没有补偿". That is illegal occupation of farmland. So that charge could apply.

Thus charges: 合同诈骗; 非法占用农用地.

Check if any other: "诈骗" generic, but we have specific contract fraud. The lexicon includes both "诈骗" and "合同诈骗". Use the more specific. So answer: [罪名]合同诈骗;非法占用农用地<eoa>

Make sure order? Not important.
